province: skip: greenhouse phytoremediation experiment (温室植物修复实验). Soil from Shengli Oil Field (Shandong) was artificially diluted with clean soil to 5000/10000/20000 mg/kg treatment levels in greenhouse pots. All TPH data presented as degradation percentages in figures (Fig.1/Fig.4), no sample-level concentration tables. Pre-remediation baseline values are artificially prepared treatment concentrations, not measured field sampling-point data.
